name: BlueCrow Capital
facts: Deep tech, AI, bioeconomy, energy transition
position: BlueCrow Capital is a Portuguese asset manager running venture-capital, private-equity and real-asset strategies. Its venture side, through the Next Tech Fund I, backs Portuguese and international founders whose R&D is recognised by the National Innovation Agency, across science-based technologies, food systems, bioeconomy and energy transition.
lede: I'm a Lisbon-based Product & RevOps manager. Your venture portfolio is small and technical, and its software companies, from Leadzai and AgentifAI to Paynest and Bandora, are where I can help most: turning strong R&D into a product that sells.
summary: BlueCrow backs R&D-intensive companies, and the gap after the R&D is almost always product and go-to-market: understanding buyers, shipping what they'll pay for, and building the sales and CS machine. I've spent nine years there, from AI-powered KYC at 14M-user scale to ad tech and customer operations in New York, and I'm comfortable working with engineers and scientists on specs and ML evaluation. Your AI, adtech and fintech companies match my background directly.

reasons.title: From R&D to revenue
reasons.body: I write specs engineers respect, from SDKs at HEROW to ML features judged on F1, and run discovery with buyers. That's the bridge R&D-led companies need.

reasons.title: AI and adtech, shipped
reasons.body: Leadzai and AgentifAI put AI in front of customers. I've shipped LLM features with evals and guardrails, and worked on ad tech from both the platform and publisher side.

reasons.title: Hands-on, from Lisbon
reasons.body: I'm based in Lisbon and speak French, English and Portuguese. I can embed with a portfolio company for a project or join full-time.

vc_notes.thesis: Deep tech, food and energy dominate; my overlap is with the AI and software companies.
vc_notes.stage: Several development stages, including around the prototype phase.
vc_notes.platform: No platform or talent function found on the website.
